input.command:
cat << 'EOF' > /home/user/gravity_sim/main.gd
extends Node3D

var ticks = 0
var probe: RigidBody3D
var samples = []
const sample_ticks = [40, 80, 120, 160, 200, 240]

func _ready():
    # Setup probe
    probe = RigidBody3D.new()
    probe.name = "Probe"
    probe.global_position = Vector3(0, 0, 0)
    probe.linear_velocity = Vector3(40, 0, 0)
    probe.mass = 1.0
    probe.gravity_scale = 1.0
    probe.linear_damp = 0.0
    probe.angular_damp = 0.0
    probe.can_sleep = false
    probe.freeze = false
    # Collision layer 1, detectable by mask 1
    probe.collision_layer = 1
    probe.collision_mask = 0

    var shape_probe = BoxShape3D.new()
    shape_probe.size = Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
    var cs_probe = CollisionShape3D.new()
    cs_probe.shape = shape_probe
    probe.add_child(cs_probe)
    add_child(probe)

    # Fields
    var field_data = [
        {
            "name": "FieldA",
            "center": Vector3(225, 0, 0),
            "size": Vector3(600, 2000, 2000),
            "override": Area3D.SPACE_OVERRIDE_COMBINE,
            "point": false,
            "direction": Vector3(1, 0, 0),
            "gravity": 3.0,
            "priority": 0,
            "point_center": Vector3.ZERO
        },
        {
            "name": "FieldB",
            "center": Vector3(30, 0, 0),
            "size": Vector3(40, 2000, 2000),
            "override": Area3D.SPACE_OVERRIDE_REPLACE_COMBINE,
            "point": false,
            "direction": Vector3(0, 1, 0),
            "gravity": 9.0,
            "priority": 10,
            "point_center": Vector3.ZERO
        },
        {
            "name": "FieldC",
            "center": Vector3(90, 0, 0),
            "size": Vector3(60, 2000, 2000),
            "override": Area3D.SPACE_OVERRIDE_COMBINE_REPLACE,
            "point": false,
            "direction": Vector3(0, 0, 1),
            "gravity": 7.0,
            "priority": 20,
            "point_center": Vector3.ZERO
        },
        {
            "name": "FieldD",
            "center": Vector3(200, 0, 0),
            "size": Vector3(160, 2000, 2000),
            "override": Area3D.SPACE_OVERRIDE_REPLACE,
            "point": true,
            "direction": Vector3.ZERO,
            "gravity": 15.0,
            "priority": 30,
            "point_center": Vector3(200, 25, 0)
        }
    ]

    for data in field_data:
        var area = Area3D.new()
        area.name = data.name
        area.global_position = data.center
        area.gravity_space_override = data.override
        area.gravity_point = data.point
        if not data.point:
            area.gravity_direction = data.direction
        else:
            area.gravity_point_center = data.point_center
            area.gravity_point_unit_distance = 0.0
        area.gravity = data.gravity
        area.priority = data.priority
        # Fields need to detect the probe (layer 1)
        area.collision_layer = 0
        area.collision_mask = 1
        area.monitoring = true

        var shape = BoxShape3D.new()
        shape.size = data.size
        var cs = CollisionShape3D.new()
        cs.shape = shape
        area.add_child(cs)
        add_child(area)

func _physics_process(_delta):
    ticks += 1

    if ticks in sample_ticks:
        var pos = probe.global_position
        var vel = probe.linear_velocity
        samples.append({
            "step": ticks,
            "position": [pos.x, pos.y, pos.z],
            "velocity": [vel.x, vel.y, vel.z]
        })

    if ticks >= 240:
        write_results()
        get_tree().quit()

func write_results():
    var result = {
        "physics_ticks_per_second": 60,
        "samples": samples
    }
    var file = FileAccess.open("res://output/result.json", FileAccess.WRITE)
    file.store_string(JSON.stringify(result))
    file.close()
EOF
echo "main.gd done"
